decisions.reason: Although the online customer portal is relatively far from the core display business, it is newly launched, publicly presented, and can still be justified as supporting deeper customer collaboration and stronger information security, so management is likely to continue it for now.

This packaging display solution fits the firm's core cardboard capabilities, supports its move into broader 3D cardboard offerings, and its 2024 packaging award gives management a strong public success to justify continued commitment.

The quarter-pallet pegboard display is close to the established offer and has visible website commitment, so a medium-sized German specialist producer would likely retain it and attribute any early weakness to normal market ramp-up.
The small counter display is an incremental extension of the firm's existing display portfolio, making it easy for management to keep backing after recent investment and public listing.

The large freestanding information display is strongly related to the firm's core business and showcased on its own page, so management would likely persist with it rather than reverse course after such a recent launch.
